finding_dispositions.evidence: Independent r7 regression found no resource-accounting regression. Invalid lexical units remain uncharged as parse.token, registry ordering and charged result construction remain intact, and the full 67-test suite passed.
Draft 2020-12 annotation propagation across allOf, contains, unevaluatedProperties, unevaluatedItems, and closed refs passed with no regression.

r7 closes direct construction, subclassing, instance-field rebinding, and callable-bearing PredicateSpec paths. However, the manifest binds _string_starts_with while production executes distinct _execute_builtin_predicate; replacing the dispatcher changed results without changing attestation.

ErrorRuleRegistry now rejects zero/direct construction and subclassing, its factory always creates the exact base type, loaded fields are frozen, and exact illegal code-phase-rule triples remain rejected.

The forged ClosedSchemaRegistry path is closed, but migration attests one function and executes another dispatcher; replacing the dispatcher changed output while provenance retained the approved digest.
Independent full and cross-implementation suites passed, with exact 250-vector coverage and all declared event boundaries.
Owning types are sealed, but MigrationSpec remains publicly constructible with arbitrary identity and digest.
